gate: Knowing arrives here as a single quiet hit, before thought has a chance to organize anything. It is the soft voice that says yes or no, turn left, leave the room, this person is safe, this one is not. The hit comes once, often barely audible, and it is gone again. There is no second proof, no argument, no chain of reasoning to walk back through. The whole body is the antenna. The teaching is in the listening, not in the talking-yourself-into-it that comes after. Most people mistake this code for anxiety, since both speak in the same low register and both arrive without warning. They are not the same. Fear projects forward, into futures that have not happened. The clear hit lands now, about now, and asks for one small movement. When this code is honoured, life moves with strange precision. When it is overruled, it goes quiet.
centre_field: The spleen sits low and to the left, the body's intuitive radar and oldest awareness centre on the map. It is older than the mind. It runs on the senses, on the moment, on a kind of animal alertness that does not need to know why. The placement matters. Put this gate higher in the map, near thought, and the signal would be debated. Put it lower, near drive, and it would be drowned by motion. Here, in the spleen, the signal sits at the level of the body itself, fast, quiet, gone in a second if not caught. The same centre carries the survival fears of the design, which is why the gift gets confused with the alarm. Both whisper. The difference is that fear loops and the clear hit lands once. To trust this centre is to take instructions from the room you are in.
channel: This gate is unusual. Most codes in the map reach toward a single partner and form one circuit; this one reaches into three, and the cluster forms a strange small web rather than a clean line. From here, the signal can travel toward behaviour and become the channel of perfected form, where intuition guides how a life is lived in the body, day by day. It can travel toward the now and become the channel of the brainwave, where the hit comes out as speech, in the moment, before the mind catches up. It can travel toward power and become the channel of power, where the same quiet read drives action through the sacral motor. Alone, this code is a fine signal with nowhere to land. Joined, depending on which partner is present, it becomes a way of moving, a way of speaking, or a way of doing.
